posts.body:
Help! My confinement nanny arrangement has fallen through, and I have to look for a new one now. I'm due first week of Oct so if anyone has any recommendations of a good one that they have used, please send me their details.

I've tried calling a few that friends have recommended but they are all booked solid for the year. I suspect many of them are.

As I'm a first time mom, ideally one that can show me the ropes & cook the usual post natal stuff - cantonese, mandarin speaking is fine. 

Thanks in advance!

posts.body:
Hi Ladies, I have a recommendation to make it you are still looking. This lady runs a domestic helper agency both in Hongkong and in the city where I live in the Mainland. I was recommended to their service by my friend. I hired a confinement lady from them and she was quite good. 

During the employment period, this Hongkong lady (Ms. Wu) travelled from Hongkong and made a home visit to us. We spoke and she seemed to be good at what she is doing. Ms.Wu is from Hongkong and she is a confinement lady herself. She speaks Cantonese ONLY. I ran into her at the hopstial in Hongkong when I took my 6 week old for vaccination. She was working for a family and also going with the baby for vaccin the same day. 

Her Hongkong contact number is 9087 9869. Even if she is not available to work perhaps she could recommend someone else. But I am sure there is a recommendation fee somehow. So, it's good to compare her quote with others.
